error_or_symptom: ORA-12170 TNS: Connect timeout
usual_cause: A security list or NSG rule, a route table entry or the on-premises firewall drops the packet. Nothing answers, so it times out
fix: Check the path in order: route table on both sides, NSG/security list ingress for 1521 from the client CIDR, on-premises firewall egress. OCI's VCN flow logs show whether the packet arrived (Ch 4)

error_or_symptom: ORA-12541 No listener
usual_cause: The packet arrived; nothing listens on that address and port. Often the scan or VIP address was not used, or the port differs
fix: lsnrctl status on the DB host; connect to the address the listener reports

error_or_symptom: ORA-12514 listener does not currently know of service
usual_cause: Wrong service name. DB system services carry the VCN domain; a PDB service is not the CDB's
fix: lsnrctl services; create an application service (Ch 14) and use it

error_or_symptom: ORA-28040 No matching authentication protocol
usual_cause: An old client (11.2 or earlier) against 19c/26ai, whose default SQLNET.ALLOWED_LOGON_VERSION_SERVER is 12
fix: Upgrade the client. As a stopgap set it to 11 in the server's sqlnet.ora, then reset the user's password so an 11G verifier exists

error_or_symptom: ORA-01017 invalid username/password after the move, same password
usual_cause: The account only has a verifier the new server will not accept, or passwords became case sensitive
fix: Check PASSWORD_VERSIONS in DBA_USERS; reset the password on the target

error_or_symptom: Connects work from OCI, fail from the office
usual_cause: The data centre's DNS cannot resolve the OCI name, or there is no route back to the client
fix: Private DNS listening endpoint and conditional forwarder (Ch 14); return route on the DRG

error_or_symptom: ORA-20401 Authorization failed for URI
usual_cause: The DBMS_CLOUD credential uses an expired or wrong auth token, the wrong user, or a URI in another region or namespace
fix: Create a new auth token, recreate the credential; copy the URI from the object's details page (Ch 5)

error_or_symptom: ORA-20404 Object not found
usual_cause: Typo in the object name, the %L/%U pattern does not match the uploaded files, or the bucket is in another compartment's region
fix: List the bucket with DBMS_CLOUD.LIST_OBJECTS using the same credential and URI prefix

error_or_symptom: ORA-39405 source time zone file version is newer than the target's
usual_cause: The target has an older time zone file than the source
fix: Upgrade the target's time zone file (DBMS_DST) before the import, or patch it with the matching DST patch. Check both versions in Chapter 2

error_or_symptom: ORA-12899 value too large for column
usual_cause: Character set conversion: a single-byte source into AL32UTF8 makes some strings longer than a VARCHAR2(n BYTE) column
fix: Scan with the Database Migration Assistant for Unicode before moving; widen the columns or use character semantics for them

error_or_symptom: ORA-39346 data loss in character set conversion
usual_cause: Source data contains characters the target character set cannot represent
fix: Same scan; fix the data at the source, or choose a target character set that holds it

error_or_symptom: ORA-39083 object type … failed to create
usual_cause: Usually a grant to a user or role that was not exported, or a dependency on a schema outside the export
fix: Read the error that follows it in the log; create the missing user or role, and re-run just those objects with INCLUDE=

error_or_symptom: ORA-01653 / ORA-01688 unable to extend
usual_cause: Tablespaces on the target are smaller than the source's used space, or not autoextend
fix: Size tablespaces from the source's used space plus growth before the import (Ch 2)

error_or_symptom: ORA-39002, ORA-39070 unable to open the log file
usual_cause: The directory object's path does not exist on the target host, or the OS user cannot write it
fix: Create the path owned by the database's OS user; on Autonomous use DATA_PUMP_DIR

error_or_symptom: Upload of a large dump file fails or restarts from zero
usual_cause: A single PUT is limited in size and restarts on any error
fix: oci os object bulk-upload with --part-size and --parallel-upload-count: multipart, resumable, checksummed (Ch 5)

error_or_symptom: ORA-16191 Primary log shipping client not logged on standby
usual_cause: The password files differ between primary and standby
fix: Copy the primary's password file to the standby (and after every SYS password change)

error_or_symptom: ORA-28374 typed master key not found in wallet
usual_cause: The standby's TDE keystore does not have the master key the primary is using — often after a rekey
fix: Copy the keystore after every key change; do not rotate keys on either side during the migration (Ch 7, 15)

error_or_symptom: ORA-01274 cannot add data file on the standby
usual_cause: A datafile was added on the primary with STANDBY_FILE_MANAGEMENT=MANUAL on the standby
fix: Set it to AUTO; recover the file entry with ALTER DATABASE CREATE DATAFILE … AS NEW, then restart apply

error_or_symptom: Apply lag grows during the batch and never catches up
usual_cause: The link's bandwidth is below the peak redo rate (Ch 7's redo query)
fix: Measure peak redo against the link before choosing the method; a bigger link, or switch over after the batch

error_or_symptom: Switchover hangs or fails VALIDATE DATABASE
usual_cause: Gaps, missing standby redo logs, or sessions still active on the primary
fix: Fix every item VALIDATE DATABASE lists; stop the application first; never force a switchover in a migration window

error_or_symptom: Standby on OCI gets a different DB_UNIQUE_NAME than expected
usual_cause: The DB system adds its own suffix
fix: Record it after the DB system is created and use it in the broker and the ZDM response file (Ch 7, 8)

error_or_symptom: zdmcli migrate database -eval fails validating the source or target
usual_cause: ZDM's SSH key is not an RSA key in PEM format, or the user lacks passwordless sudo
fix: Generate with ssh-keygen -m PEM -t rsa; check sudo -l for the OS user ZDM logs in as (Ch 8)

error_or_symptom: ZDM cannot reach a host it was given
usual_cause: The ZDM host resolves names differently from the source and target
fix: Make every host resolve every other by the same name — DNS or /etc/hosts on all three

error_or_symptom: Job stops at a phase with no obvious error
usual_cause: The real message is in the job's log on the ZDM host, not the summary
fix: zdmcli query job -jobid N shows the log path; read the phase's log; zdmcli resume job after the fix

error_or_symptom: Logical: replication lag above GOLDENGATESETTINGS_ACCEPTABLELAG
usual_cause: Large transactions, tables without keys, or an undersized hub
fix: Add keys or use all columns as key; size the GoldenGate hub; wait out the batch before resuming (Ch 9)

error_or_symptom: Logical: rows differ after cutover
usual_cause: Unsupported data types or objects were never replicated
fix: Run Ch 9's find_unreplicable.sql before; load those tables in the window

error_or_symptom: Logical: duplicate key errors on new rows after cutover
usual_cause: Sequences on the target start where the export left them
fix: Compare and raise sequences in the window (Ch 9's compare_sequences.sql)

error_or_symptom: ORA-01031 insufficient privileges for a DBA task
usual_cause: There is no SYS or SYSDBA on Autonomous; ADMIN is powerful but not SYS
fix: Use the documented package or console action; remove OS-level and SYS-only steps from runbooks (Ch 10)

error_or_symptom: ORA-01950 no privileges on tablespace
usual_cause: A user created on Autonomous has no quota on DATA
fix: GRANT UNLIMITED TABLESPACE or a quota on DATA

error_or_symptom: Code using OS paths, external jobs or UTL_FILE paths fails
usual_cause: There is no host file system to reach
fix: Object Storage with DBMS_CLOUD; CPAT lists these before the move

error_or_symptom: Dates are hours off
usual_cause: SYSDATE returns UTC on Autonomous
fix: Set SYSDATE_AT_DBTIMEZONE and the database time zone, or use CURRENT_DATE deliberately (Ch 10)

error_or_symptom: AutoUpgrade stops at prechecks
usual_cause: Fixable items are not fixed automatically in analyze mode
fix: Run -mode analyze early, read the HTML report, fix or let fixups fix them before the window (Ch 11)

error_or_symptom: Many invalid objects after the upgrade
usual_cause: Normal until recompiled; a few stay invalid because they were invalid before
fix: utlrp.sql; compare with the invalid list taken before the upgrade

error_or_symptom: No way back after a non-CDB to PDB conversion
usual_cause: A restore point cannot undo the conversion
fix: Keep the source until sign-off; that is the rollback (Ch 11, 15)

error_or_symptom: AutoConfig fails on the new database tier
usual_cause: The context file still names the old host, port or SID; or the PDB service is wrong
fix: Regenerate the context with adbldxml.pl; check s_dbhost, s_dbport, the PDB service (Ch 12, 13)

error_or_symptom: Old nodes still in FND_NODES
usual_cause: Configuration from the source was carried across
fix: Clean FND_NODES with FND_CONC_CLONE.SETUP_CLEAN, then AutoConfig on every tier, database first

error_or_symptom: Workflow mail stops
usual_cause: Port 25 blocked, or the mailer still points at the old relay
fix: Email Delivery on 587, or your relay over VPN; update the mailer's outbound settings (Ch 14)

error_or_symptom: Host-type concurrent programs fail on Linux
usual_cause: AIX/Solaris scripts or binaries carried across
fix: Rebuild and run each once in UAT (Ch 13's find_custom_binaries.sh)

error_or_symptom: ORA-29278 SMTP transient error / timeout
usual_cause: Outbound port 25 blocked from OCI
fix: OCI Email Delivery on 587 with STARTTLS and SMTP credentials (Ch 14)

error_or_symptom: ORA-24247 network access denied by ACL
usual_cause: The ACL for that host and port was not on the target
fix: DBMS_NETWORK_ACL_ADMIN.APPEND_HOST_ACE for the owning schema

error_or_symptom: ORA-29283 invalid file operation
usual_cause: The directory path does not exist on the new host, or is owned by root
fix: Create every DBA_DIRECTORIES path before testing (Ch 14)

error_or_symptom: ORA-29024 certificate validation failure
usual_cause: The UTL_HTTP wallet is missing the site's root certificate, or the path in code is wrong
fix: Copy or rebuild the wallet at the path the code uses (Ch 14)

error_or_symptom: Jobs ran twice
usual_cause: Jobs enabled on both databases
fix: job_queue_processes=0 on the target until cutover (Ch 14, 15)

error_or_symptom: Some clients still reach the old server
usual_cause: Long DNS TTL, or clients that cache DNS
fix: Lower the TTL a week ahead; restart caching clients at cutover

error_or_symptom: Screens slower; database time per execution unchanged
usual_cause: Round trips over VPN to an application tier left behind
fix: Move the application tier; fetch more per call (Ch 16)

error_or_symptom: One statement much slower
usual_cause: Plan changed
fix: Load the source's plan from the tuning set as a baseline for that SQL ID (Ch 16)

error_or_symptom: Batch twice as long
usual_cause: Smaller SGA or different parallel settings on the new system
fix: Diff parameters; match the source first (Ch 16)

error_or_symptom: High physical reads all morning
usual_cause: Cold cache, or a buffer cache smaller than the source's
fix: Wait an hour before judging; then compare cache sizes

error_or_symptom: Storage bill does not fall after the migration
usual_cause: Dump files left in the bucket; uncommitted multipart uploads from failed uploads
fix: Delete the dumps after sign-off; add a lifecycle rule that aborts uncommitted multipart uploads after a few days

error_or_symptom: A terminated instance still costs money
usual_cause: Its boot volume was preserved on termination
fix: Storage → Block Storage → Boot volumes: delete the detached ones you no longer need

error_or_symptom: Two databases billed for months
usual_cause: The OCI standby or the rehearsal copy was never removed
fix: Every rehearsal environment has an owner and an end date in the runbook

error_or_symptom: Licence count higher than expected
usual_cause: OCPUs counted against BYOL entitlements without checking the conversion
fix: Check the processor licence rule for OCI with your Oracle account manager before choosing shapes (Ch 3)
